I couldn't get the test passing, because I'm not able to write to `app/calc.py`.

**Cause of the failure:** `mean` in `app/calc.py` divides by `len(values) - 1` instead of `len(values)`. That's an off-by-one bug. `mean([2, 4, 6])` returns 6.0 when it should return 4.

**Fix:** change the last line to `return sum(values) / len(values)`.

**What blocked me:** `/work/app` and `app/calc.py` are owned by root and read-only (`dr-xr-xr-x` and `-r--r--r--`). I'm running as `agent`, so my edit failed with EACCES. I haven't tried to get around the permissions, such as with chmod or sudo. Someone set them that way, and I don't know if that was deliberate.

**Decision for you:** either make the file writable for me (or apply the one-line change yourself), or tell me explicitly that I may change the permissions and I'll make the edit and re-run the tests.

I also found that `.agent/notes.md` only says the previous session explored the repo and ran the tests, so it had nothing useful on this bug.
